title: borreria poaya var. genuina
intro: Borreria poaya var. genuina, commonly known as the Guatemalan or Mexican Borreria, is a plant species within the Rubiaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The health benefits of Borreria poaya var. genuina include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, as well as fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
